hints.title: Bit Pair Transition Analysis
hints.text: Examine what happens when applying the bitwise operation to pairs: (0, 1) becomes (1, 1), and (1, 1) can become (1, 0).

hints.title: Preservation of Ones
hints.text: A string of all zeros can never create any ones. As long as at least one 1 exists, other bits can be toggled arbitrarily.

hints.title: Existence Equivalence
hints.text: Transformation is possible if and only if both s and target have at least one 1, or both consist entirely of 0s.

hints.title: Bit Presence Invariant Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass testing for presence of '1' character.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all combinations of bitwise pair operations causes state explosion.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that the operation can propagate or consume ones as long as at least one 1 remains.
